ruling.recommended_action: Refund $4.22 (unexempt detour mileage 2.99 km × $1.41/km) to the rider's Ryde voucher; note the driver's RD-1 breach (shortest-and-most-direct-route duty) on file; no account flag.

segment_findings.reason: Rider named Paya Lebar Square as a stop, but the GPS record shows 4.63 km driven where the optimal route covers 1.64 km (+2.99 km, up to 731 m off route) — the consent in [F9]/[F10] (scoped by RD-5) covers 'a stop', not this route change, and RD-3(a) does not shelter the mileage. Traffic facts [F13][F14] are speed band 4 only, which is corroborative and cannot alone exempt under RD-4(b), and [F15] records no incident on the optimal route, so RD-4 does not apply. Segment counts; amount per RD-2 = 2.99 km × $1.41/km = $4.22.

rejected_claims.reason: Only the unexempt segment's extra mileage is refundable under RD-2; the map-matching residual between the 3.5 km billed excess [F1] and the 2.99 km segment [F4] is not refunded, and the base/time/platform components are the metered fare on the actual route.

Driver statement [F12] attributes all extra driving to the rider's requested stop, but under RD-5 consent is limited to the named stop; the GPS off-route segment [F4] shows additional unagreed mileage.
The $1.04 waiting charge [F6] is meter waiting time for the requested 4-minute stop (F2); RD-3(c) — RydeTAXI waiting time is chargeable and not refunded.
